description_en: Queries the connection information of an instance
name: DescribeDBInstanceNetInfo

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The endpoint that is used to connect to the instance.

If you do not specify this parameter, the information about all endpoints of the instance is returned
parameters.help_zh:
数据库连接地址。

如果不指定该参数，将会返回所有数据库连接地址的相关信息
parameters.name: connection_string
